review.note: Swap deciding rule 707.10 for 707.12: Isochron Scepter's copy IS cast (707.12), so 'a copy isn't cast' is the wrong mechanism; Null Profusion doesn't trigger because the cast copy is not a card. Keep 603.2.

question: Does Null Profusion's triggered ability trigger when I play a copy of a card, such as with Isochron Scepter?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it triggers when you play a land card or cast a nonland card as a spell, not when you play a copy of a card.
expected.answer: The triggered ability will trigger when you play a land card or cast a nonland card as a spell. It won't trigger when you play a copy of a card, such as with Isochron Scepter.
